rules.name: cs-36-ssv-cfs-who-when-what-process
rules.sql: SELECT x.value_date, x.created_by, x.updated_by, count(*) AS rows, min(coalesce(x.updated_timestamp, x.created_timestamp)) AS first_write, max(coalesce(x.updated_timestamp, x.created_timestamp)) AS last_write FROM opera.security_settlement_value_table x WHERE x.tenant_id = :tenant AND x.business_unit = 'CFS' GROUP BY x.value_date, x.created_by, x.updated_by ORDER BY x.value_date

SELECT x.business_unit, x.value_date, x.created_by, count(*) AS rows, min(x.created_timestamp) AS first_write, max(x.created_timestamp) AS last_write FROM opera.security_settlement_value_table x WHERE x.tenant_id = :tenant AND x.business_unit <> 'CFS' GROUP BY x.business_unit, x.value_date, x.created_by ORDER BY x.business_unit, x.value_date

SELECT s.tablename, s.business_unit, s.valuation_date, s.status_type, s.status, s.settle_type, s.created_by, s.created_timestamp, s.updated_by, s.updated_timestamp FROM opera.status_table s WHERE s.tenant_id = :tenant AND upper(s.business_unit) = 'CFS' AND s.created_timestamp >= TIMESTAMP '2026-11-18 00:00:00' ORDER BY s.created_timestamp

SELECT v.business_unit, v.value_date, v.settlement_date, v.created_by, v.created_timestamp, v.updated_by, v.updated_timestamp FROM opera.valuation_date_table v WHERE v.tenant_id = :tenant AND upper(v.business_unit) = 'CFS'

SELECT u.value_date, u.created_by, CAST(u.created_timestamp AS date) AS created_on, count(*) AS rows, min(u.created_timestamp) AS first_write, max(u.created_timestamp) AS last_write FROM opera.underlying_settle_value_table u WHERE u.tenant_id = :tenant AND u.value_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-11-18' AND DATE '2026-11-24' GROUP BY u.value_date, u.created_by, CAST(u.created_timestamp AS date) ORDER BY u.value_date, created_on
